localChanges: You can now put a city on Auto with the Auto button next to Change and Buy on the city screen, or next to View city in the production window, and press A on the city screen to turn it on or off. A city on Auto chooses its next improvement or Wonder by itself whenever a build finishes: a Granary when it's starving, an Aqueduct as it nears size 10, a Temple when its citizens are unhappy, a Marketplace or Library as its trade grows, and Barracks and City Walls first when an enemy is close. The city screen shows "Auto" under what it's building, and Stop Auto keeps the current build and hands the choice back to you (closes #194).
Computer players now choose their improvements the same way, by what each city needs, instead of picking one at random.
